title: The McCoys Album Cover
coreRelationships: The band members are the central human subjects, positioned around the airplane.
The airplane serves as a large prop and background element, establishing a travel or adventure theme.
The typography at the top forms a distinct, layered header contrasting with the photographic content.
The yellow and orange hues of the airplane and the sky/text background create a warm, vibrant color scheme.
reuseFormula: Recreate the visual style by applying a bold, condensed, uppercase sans-serif typeface with a distinct 3D effect (dark blue fill, light blue outline, yellow-orange offset shadow) for the primary title. Use a vibrant yellow-orange solid background for the main titles and a contrasting blue solid band for the tracklist, which should be in white bold uppercase sans-serif. Maintain a high-saturation color palette and a clear, layered typographic hierarchy.
